text:
Alex: Heads-up — small runtime kernel bump (v2.1) scheduled for 22:00 UTC tonight. Affects runtime binary and KV eviction behavior. Need quick compat check and rollback plan. @Sam @Maya @deploy-bot

Sam: Noted. API team: any changes to response headers or shard routing that could break the router?

Maya: We changed the router header parity last week; runtime patch doesn't touch header parsing, but it does tweak kv-eviction which could affect cold-start latency. Console may want an optional field `eviction_stats` for debugging.

Devon: Router: header parity OK. Runtime changing eviction timing might increase short tail latency during warmup. Plan: pin old runtime variant for 1h canary. @deploy-bot please stagger canary 5% -> 50% over 20m and monitor retry/error spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: runtime:v2.1 -> canary group 'canary-a' 5% at 22:00 UTC. Auto-rollback thresholds: error rate > 2x baseline OR p95 latency > 200ms.

Chris: Console: I'll add `eviction_stats` as an optional field (schema v1.4). Will open PR.

Sam: API will accept optional `eviction_stats` and won't require it. No client-facing contract changes.

Alex: Also: set pins — API pinned to api:runtime-compatible build, Router pinned to keep header-split flag. If canary fails, we rollback runtime only; API/router remain stable.

Maya: Add manual rollback triggers to runbook: if p50 > 120ms OR error rate > 1.5x then manual rollback and paging. Also collect model-regeneration logs and KV hit-rate.

Devon: Router will enable hedging backoff during canary to avoid retry storms. Config snippet:
```yaml
router:
  hedging_enabled: true
  max_retries: 1
  retry_backoff_ms: 50
```

Chris: PR #3421 created for console schema, CI green.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary run started at 22:00:05 UTC -> canary 5% deployed. Monitoring hooks: prometheus alert group `release/runtime-v2.1` and dashboard 'runtime/canary-v2.1'.

Alex: Monitoring: page oncall for any alert spike.

Olga: :+1: I'll watch the alerts and escalate.

Sam: After 1h stable, we'll auto-unpin and promote to 100% over 30m. Post-mortem note: record pin duration and any infra mitigations.

Devon: If we need immediate rollback, I'll coordinate router control-plane shift to route traffic to runtime:v2.0 variants. Confirm console/API remain backward compatible.

Alex: Everyone ack? :thumbsup:

Sam: :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
Devon: :thumbsup:
Chris: :thumbsup:
Olga: :thumbsup:
